children: Phoenix agreed to buy AI workforce platform Fuel50 for about $31.5 million in cash, with up to $8.5 million in earnouts, expected to close within 30 days.
Agreement to acquire Fuel50 via merger for an aggregate cash purchase price of approximately $31.5M.
Former Fuel50 securityholders may receive up to $8.5M in earnouts through 2027 tied to performance milestones.
Acquisition funded with cash on hand and subject to customary closing conditions and Fuel50 stockholder approval.
Fuel50 expected to operate as a distinct, wholly owned subsidiary under its own brand after closing.
Transaction expected to close within 30 days, integration and benefits remain subject to customary risks and uncertainties.
